reviews.title: Big performance, small price
reviews.comment: I went big on storage and picked up three KLEVV CRAS C910 2TB NVMe drives, and I’m using all of them purely as game drives. That’s 6TB dedicated just to gaming, and honestly, it feels amazing never having to think about uninstalling anything. Performance is exactly what you’d want from a Gen4 NVMe. Games launch almost instantly, load screens are basically gone, and swapping between massive titles is seamless. I’ve got huge libraries installed across all three drives—AAA games, MMOs, indies, you name it—and they all run buttery smooth. It’s kind of wild to have this much ultra-fast storage dedicated just to games, but it means my entire collection is always ready to go. Thermals are great too. Each drive comes with its own slim heatsink, and even with all three installed, I haven’t run into throttling or overheating. The heatsinks don’t get in the way of anything else in my build, and they do their job keeping temps in check. What I love most is the peace of mind. I don’t have to juggle installs anymore or pick and choose what stays on my system. And because the drives are consistent, I don’t notice any difference in performance no matter which one I’m loading from. If you’re the kind of gamer who wants your entire library installed and running at top speed, stacking a few of these KLEVV CRAS C910s is absolutely worth it. For me, it’s been the perfect storage solution—fast, reliable, and plenty of space to let me game without limits.
reviews.author: Josh

reviews.title: The drive works as suggested at the posted speeds
reviews.comment: Its been a great drive for me. Used for a while now. I did purchase it before the price jump. So for me it was great value. Hopefully it'll go back down. But all in all the ratings are all correct. I personally use it to store all my games on.

reviews.title: Best for budget build. Hoping it will last!!
reviews.comment: Best price for a budget build and wanting 2tb. 1tb doesn’t cut it anymore with the size of the games theses days. This also looks great in the build, reflecting some rgb lighting for a cool effect. I can’t talk about reliability yet.. hoping it last for years to come.
